lines.zh: 蹄子落地，身后冒出一朵黄花。
lines.en: My hoof lands, and a yellow flower rises behind.

lines.zh: 走慢些，让花跟上我的脚步。
lines.en: Slow down a little, so the flowers keep up.

lines.zh: 蜜蜂在背上打转，我不赶它。
lines.en: Bees circle my back; I do not shoo them.

lines.zh: 花林的草软，踩上去像毯子。
lines.en: Flower forest grass feels like a soft carpet.

lines.zh: 我绕着花圃走，不踩坏任何一朵。
lines.en: I walk around the beds, crushing no blossoms.

lines.zh: 背上那丛花，走起来会晃。
lines.en: The blooms on my back sway as I go.

lines.zh: 每一步都开一朵，回头看看。
lines.en: A flower for every step; I glance back at them.

lines.zh: 蜜蜂说那边花多，我就往那边。
lines.en: The bees say more flowers that way, so I go.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，我换个方向吃草。
lines.en: The sun shifted, so I graze facing elsewhere.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，惊起一片花瓣。
lines.en: One tail flick stirs a cloud of petals.

lines.zh: 沿着小溪走，水边花开得早。
lines.en: I follow the brook, where flowers open earliest.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，花才来得及长。
lines.en: I walk slowly so the flowers can keep pace.

lines.zh: 蹄印里积了露水，蜜蜂去喝。
lines.en: Dew pools in my prints, and the bees drink.

lines.zh: 花林的路我熟，闭眼也不会撞树。
lines.en: I know these paths; I could walk blind.

lines.zh: 我抬头闻了闻，往开得密的那边走。
lines.en: I raise my nose and head for the thickest blooms.

lines.zh: 蹄边新开的一朵，我绕过去了。
lines.en: A new blossom opened by my hoof. I step around it.

lines.zh: 反刍的时候，蜜蜂在我耳边哼。
lines.en: As I chew, the bees hum beside my ear.

lines.zh: 背上这丛花，今天开得正好。
lines.en: The flowers on my back are blooming just right today.

lines.zh: 有只蜜蜂钻进我的毛里打盹。
lines.en: One bee has crawled into my fur to nap.

lines.zh: 哞一声，远处的牛也回一声。
lines.en: I moo once, and a distant cow moos back.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，花还是照开。
lines.en: I stand still, and the flowers keep opening anyway.

lines.zh: 花瓣落了一地，都是我的。
lines.en: Petals fall all around me, and all are mine.

lines.zh: 舔舔鼻子，尝到花粉的甜。
lines.en: I lick my nose and taste sweet pollen.

lines.zh: 这片花林安静得只剩翅膀声。
lines.en: This grove is so quiet only wings remain.

lines.zh: 痒，背上有东西在爬。
lines.en: It tickles; something is crawling on my back.

lines.zh: 我甩甩耳朵，赶不走蜜蜂。
lines.en: I flap my ears, and the bees stay anyway.

lines.zh: 雨要来的时候，花会先低头。
lines.en: When rain comes, the flowers bow first.

lines.zh: 今晚睡在哪丛花边上好呢。
lines.en: Which patch of flowers should I sleep beside tonight?

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，像刚割过的草。
lines.en: You smell like freshly cut grass.

lines.zh: 蜜蜂不躲你，说明你没恶意。
lines.en: The bees do not flee you, so you mean no harm.

lines.zh: 你头上戴花，我就多看你两眼。
lines.en: You wear a flower, so I look twice.

lines.zh: 手里拿的是麦子吗？
lines.en: Is that wheat in your hand?

lines.zh: 别踩那朵，它刚开。
lines.en: Not that one; it has just opened.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，是想摸我的花？
lines.en: You crouch down; do you want to touch my flowers?

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，嘴里还嚼着草。
lines.en: I look up at you, still chewing grass.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾了别的花的花粉。
lines.en: Your boots carry pollen from other flowers.

lines.zh: 看我可以，别摘我背上的。
lines.en: Look all you like, but do not pick mine.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，我脸上有花？
lines.en: What are you smiling at? Is there a flower on my face?

lines.zh: 哞——这一下真疼。
lines.en: Moo — that one truly hurt.

lines.zh: 我背上的花被撞散了。
lines.en: The flowers on my back were knocked apart.

lines.zh: 退两步，我看看是谁。
lines.en: Two steps back, and I see who did it.

lines.zh: 皮厚，可也架不住这么砍。
lines.en: My hide is thick, but not against such chopping.

lines.zh: 蜜蜂炸了群，围着我转。
lines.en: The hive bursts into panic and swirls around me.

lines.zh: 角尖对着你，我先低头再说。
lines.en: Horns aimed at you, and only then do I lower them.

lines.zh: 疼得我蹄子刨地。
lines.en: The pain makes my hooves scrape the dirt.

lines.zh: 花掉了，我顾不上捡。
lines.en: The flowers fell, and I cannot stop to gather them.

lines.zh: 别打了，我只是头吃草的牛。
lines.en: Stop; I am only a grass-eating cow.

lines.zh: 我往花丛里躲，花能挡一挡。
lines.en: I hide in the flowerbed; the stems screen me.

lines.zh: 小麦？我吃，但我更爱花。
lines.en: Wheat? I eat it, but I love flowers more.

lines.zh: 你手里那束花，比麦子香。
lines.en: That bunch you hold smells better than wheat.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走过来，别急着喂。
lines.en: I come over slowly; do not rush the feeding.

lines.zh: 蜜蜂先到了，你排后面。
lines.en: The bees got here first; you wait in line.

lines.zh: 麦子落地，我低头就吃。
lines.en: The wheat drops, and my head goes down.

lines.zh: 手腕一转，我就把蹄子挪过去。
lines.en: Turn your wrist once, and my hooves shift over.

lines.zh: 花林的草够吃，可你的更好。
lines.en: The grove feeds me, but yours tastes better.

lines.zh: 我认你的手，不认你的声音。
lines.en: I know your hands, not your voice.

lines.zh: 喂我可以，别摸角。
lines.en: Feed me if you like, but leave my horns.

lines.zh: 再给一把，我就跟你走。
lines.en: One more handful, and I will follow you.

lines.zh: 撞到我的肚子，软软的。
lines.en: You bumped my flank; it is soft.

lines.zh: 你让一让，我背上的花怕挤。
lines.en: Step aside; the flowers on my back bruise easily.

lines.zh: 我转身慢，你先退开。
lines.en: I turn slowly, so move back first.

lines.zh: 这一下把花瓣都撞落了。
lines.en: That bump knocked half my petals loose.

lines.zh: 别推我，蜜蜂会不高兴。
lines.en: Do not push; the bees will not like it.

lines.zh: 我侧过身子，花丛就开了道缝。
lines.en: I turn sideways, and the flowerbed opens a seam.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩到你的脚了，抱歉。
lines.en: My hoof landed on your foot; sorry.

lines.zh: 挤在花丛里，谁都不好过。
lines.en: Packed in the flowerbed, neither of us is happy.

lines.zh: 你撞我，我只会往旁边挪。
lines.en: Bump me, and I only shift sideways.

lines.zh: 小心角，我低头的时候很硬。
lines.en: Mind the horns; they are hard when I lower them.

lines.zh: 两头牛并排，花就开成一片。
lines.en: Two cows side by side, and the flowers merge.

lines.zh: 我们在花林深处慢慢转圈。
lines.en: We circle slowly deep in the flower forest.

lines.zh: 它的花比我艳，我认了。
lines.en: Its blooms are brighter than mine; I accept it.

lines.zh: 小牛生下来，背上就有芽。
lines.en: The calf is born with a sprout on its back.

lines.zh: 蜜蜂跟着我们，一路唱。
lines.en: The bees follow us, humming the whole way.

lines.zh: 角碰角，就算说定了。
lines.en: Horn against horn, and it is settled.

lines.zh: 这一片花田，够养两头牛。
lines.en: This flower field can feed two cows.

lines.zh: 我给它舔毛，它给我让草。
lines.en: I groom its coat; it yields me the grass.

lines.zh: 春天配对，夏天就有小牛。
lines.en: Paired in spring, and by summer a calf.

lines.zh: 我们走同一圈，花就围成环。
lines.en: We walk one circle, and flowers ring us.

lines.zh: 地上的花，我叼起来插背上。
lines.en: I pick up fallen flowers and tuck them in.

lines.zh: 这朵被踩坏了，可惜。
lines.en: This one was trampled; a pity.

lines.zh: 我把落花拢到蹄边。
lines.en: I nudge the fallen petals to my hooves.

lines.zh: 捡到一朵蒲公英，蜜蜂很喜欢。
lines.en: I found a dandelion, and the bees approve.

lines.zh: 花籽粘在毛上，我带走。
lines.en: Seeds cling to my coat, and I carry them off.

lines.zh: 低头捡草，抬头花就开了。
lines.en: I lower my head, and a flower opens above.

lines.zh: 落下的花瓣，我一片片收。
lines.en: I gather the fallen petals one by one.

lines.zh: 这块地上的花归我照看。
lines.en: The flowers here are under my care.

lines.zh: 我嘴里叼着花，走得很得意。
lines.en: With a flower in my mouth, I strut a little.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，蜜蜂先看。
lines.en: Dropped things get inspected by the bees first.

lines.zh: 那片野花开了，我这就过去。
lines.en: That wild patch has bloomed; I head over.

lines.zh: 远处的花林更密，我认得路。
lines.en: The far grove is denser, and I know the way.

lines.zh: 有只蜜蜂指了个方向，我跟上。
lines.en: A bee points a direction, and I follow.

lines.zh: 谁在那片草地上撒了花种？
lines.en: Who scattered flower seeds on that lawn?

lines.zh: 目标：那丛向日葵下面的嫩草。
lines.en: Target: tender grass beneath those sunflowers.

lines.zh: 我看中那棵树下的阴凉了。
lines.en: I have my eye on that shade under the tree.

lines.zh: 那边花开得好，我去看看。
lines.en: The flowers look good over there; I will look.

lines.zh: 我盯着一朵花，慢慢走过去。
lines.en: Eyes on one blossom, I walk over slowly.

lines.zh: 有牛在叫，我得过去应一声。
lines.en: A cow is calling; I should go answer.

lines.zh: 小牛跑远了，我追上去。
lines.en: The calf has wandered; I go after it.

lines.zh: 一步一步，别惊动那片花。
lines.en: Step by step, without startling the flowers.

lines.zh: 再近一点，就能闻到花蜜。
lines.en: A little closer and I will smell nectar.

lines.zh: 蜜蜂绕着我转，替我引路。
lines.en: The bees circle me, showing the way.

lines.zh: 我加快蹄子，花在背上晃。
lines.en: I quicken my hooves; my flowers sway.

lines.zh: 它就在前面，我低头吃就行。
lines.en: It is right ahead; I only need to lower my head.

lines.zh: 这丛草看起来最嫩。
lines.en: This clump looks the most tender.

lines.zh: 我盯着那朵，眼里没别的。
lines.en: I fix on that blossom and nothing else.

lines.zh: 别挡路，我要过去那丛花。
lines.en: Do not block me; I am heading to those flowers.

lines.zh: 路不远，可我不想跑。
lines.en: Not far, but I have no wish to run.

lines.zh: 闻着味走，错不了。
lines.en: Follow the scent and I cannot go wrong.

lines.zh: 我顶一下，只是想让你让开。
lines.en: One nudge of my horns, only to move you.

lines.zh: 角撞到你，我马上退。
lines.en: My horns hit you, and I back off at once.

lines.zh: 别抢我的花，我会顶人。
lines.en: Do not take my flowers; I do push back.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，你该懂了。
lines.en: That was not hard; you should understand now.

lines.zh: 我低头冲了两步，就停住。
lines.en: I lower my head, charge two steps, and stop.

lines.zh: 蜜蜂被吓到了，我才动手。
lines.en: The bees got frightened, so I acted.

lines.zh: 蹄子刨地，是警告不是攻击。
lines.en: Hooves scraping soil is a warning, not a charge.

lines.zh: 撞完我自己也晃了一下。
lines.en: After the bump I wobble a little too.

lines.zh: 护着小牛的时候，我可不客气。
lines.en: Guarding my calf, I show no courtesy.

lines.zh: 顶开你就跑，我不想打。
lines.en: I shove you aside and run; I dislike fighting.

lines.zh: 花林里多了一头牛，背上有花。
lines.en: The grove gains a cow with flowers on its back.

lines.zh: 我睁眼，先看见一丛雏菊。
lines.en: I open my eyes to a clump of daisies.

lines.zh: 出生的地方，蜜蜂已经在了。
lines.en: Where I was born, the bees were already waiting.

lines.zh: 蹄子第一次落地，踩出一朵花。
lines.en: My first step pressed a flower into being.

lines.zh: 母亲舔了我一身，花籽也舔进来。
lines.en: Mother licked me clean, seeds and all.

lines.zh: 这片花林从此多一个吃草的。
lines.en: This grove now has one more grazer.

lines.zh: 我站起来，背上那朵也跟着立起。
lines.en: I stand, and the bloom on my back rises too.

lines.zh: 风里有蜜味，我知道该往哪走。
lines.en: The wind smells of nectar; I know where to go.

lines.zh: 第一声哞，蜜蜂都飞起来。
lines.en: My first moo sends the bees into the air.

lines.zh: 草很高，我只露出角和花。
lines.en: The grass is tall; only horns and flowers show.

lines.zh: 毛烧起来，蜜蜂全跑了。
lines.en: My coat catches fire, and the bees scatter.

lines.zh: 从坡上滑下去，花撒了一路。
lines.en: I slide down the slope, scattering flowers behind.

lines.zh: 我在水里扑腾，花全湿了。
lines.en: I thrash in the water; my flowers are soaked.

lines.zh: 炸得我转了三圈，花都没了。
lines.en: The blast spins me three times; my flowers are gone.

lines.zh: 箭插在背上，正好扎进花丛里。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back, right among the flowers.

lines.zh: 药水浇下来，我的花立刻蔫了。
lines.en: Potion splashes down and my flowers wilt at once.

lines.zh: 草被吃光了，我饿得站不稳。
lines.en: The grass is gone, and hunger makes me sway.

lines.zh: 雷落在花田，我吓得跪下了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the field; I drop to my knees.

lines.zh: 下面空空的，我的花先掉了下去。
lines.en: Nothing below; my flowers fall away first.
